title: Kestrel 7-Day Return — Program Limits on Window, Mileage, Exchanges and Handback
content:
The Kestrel 7-Day Return on Vehicle Purchase Agreements runs on the following program limits.

| Vehicle program | Return window (calendar days after handover) | Mileage allowance (miles driven with no excess-mileage fee) | Mileage hard cap (miles driven above which no return is accepted) | Days after the request to hand the vehicle back | Returns per exchange chain |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | 7 | 250 | 400 | 3 | 1 |
| Kestrel Inspected | 7 | 400 | 600 | 3 | 1 |
| Kestrel Certified | 7 | 400 | 600 | 3 | 1 |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | 7 | 400 | 700 | 3 | 1 |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | 7 | 500 | 800 | 5 | 1 |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | 7 | 500 | 800 | 5 | 1 |

**Terms common to all six programs.**
- The 7-day right may be used as an exchange for another Kestrel vehicle.
- The customer may bring a returned vehicle to a Kestrel hub instead of using home pickup.
- One 7-day return or exchange is available across an original order and any exchange replacement that came from it.

**Reading the mileage columns.** Miles driven are counted from the handover odometer. Under Kestrel Certified Plus, 400 miles driven are within the allowance, 401 to 700 miles are above the allowance but not above the hard cap, and 701 miles are above the hard cap.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Kestrel Premium Certified vehicle handed over on day 0 has a return window whose last day is day 7; if the request is made on day 6, the vehicle is to be handed back by day 11.
